purpose: Application service that assembles the backend-owned storefront home response from PostgreSQL and media records.
businessRules: Public storefront home reads are KV-first with DB fallback.
Home response includes brand, navigation, hero, trust, featured collections, bestsellers, why SHRESTA, material stories, and newsletter sections.
ProductCard responses include customer-facing short descriptions from storefront_home_items.description and long descriptions from metadata.longDescription.
Featured collection item counts are computed from active backend product-card records in the storefront response.

Any collection can provide metadata.productBadgeFilters; counts are then derived from backend product badges/tags with normalized token matching rather than slug-specific code or static metadata counts.
Storefront home KV uses active:v8 so reference-catalog seed expansion, copy normalization, and product response-shape changes do not reuse stale Redis payloads.
Media assets include CDN-compatible backend-versioned URLs, versions, dimensions, delivery mode, LQIP, and responsive variants.
Storefront section/item writes refresh home KV only after database commit.
